pNone_chapter_1: Byomkesh and Ajit sit opposite each other in a dimly lit, high-ceilinged room filled with wooden bookshelves and stacks of paper. Byomkesh leans back in a woven cane chair, a thin trail of smoke rising from the cheroot held between his fingers as he gazes thoughtfully toward the ceiling. Ajit sits across from him, holding an open newspaper across his lap and looking toward his friend with a slight, knowing smile. Warm afternoon sunlight filters through heavy wooden shutters, casting long shadows across the floor and highlighting the textures of their white cotton dhoti-kurtas. The atmosphere is quiet and contemplative, thick with the stillness of a slow afternoon.
